derivation: crsp_panel._decision caps every decision at protocol.max_universe.
262000 eligible paths = 262 decisions * 1000 maximum members, so every decision has exactly 1000 members.
The native audit enumerates all features inside each decision consecutively, incrementing checked before recording path_ordinal.
Deduplicate these ordinals by period; crsp_study_rows uses every member in each decision mean.
limitations: Derived from frozen protocol and existing native metadata; no new licensed-data read or native execution.
25000 benchmark-dependent rows is not a count of incorrect or flipped labels, selected holdings, or realized loss.
No rows removed, returns imputed, protocol amended, candidate admitted, or final partition opened.
